name: Jailbreak Testsim
source:
Jailbreak Testsim is a short visual novel based on the [url=https://mspfa.com/?s=35904]Jailbreak^2[/url] and [url=https://mspfa.com/?s=36446]TEST STUCK[/url] webcomics, might be a little confusing if you don't know them but I hope that you can find it funny either way.

[From [url=https://fruzmig.itch.io/jailbreak-testsim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Jailbreak Testsim》是一部以网络漫画[url=https://mspfa.com/?s=35904]《Jailbreak^2》[/url]和[url=https://mspfa.com/?s=36446]《TEST STUCK》[/url]为基础的短篇视觉小说。如果你不了解这两部漫画，可能会有点看不懂，不过希望你依然能觉得有趣。

[来源：[url=https://fruzmig.itch.io/jailbreak-testsim]Itch.io[/url]]
